# BrandMakingTractor

> BrandMakingTractor is a digital marketing and creative growth partner based in India, serving businesses in Patna, Bangalore, Coimbatore and across the country. Each project is matched with a specialist and measured against business outcomes.

## Services
- [Performance Marketing](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/performance-marketing): Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads with conversion tracking and optimisation.
- [SEO / AEO / GEO](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/seo-aeo-geo): Technical, on-page and local SEO, Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization.
- [Website Development](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/website-development): Custom and WordPress websites, landing pages, GTM/GA4 and CRM integration.
- [Branding](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/branding): Brand strategy, visual identity and guidelines.
- [Content Marketing](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/content-marketing): Strategy-led website, blog, SEO and social content.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/social-media-marketing): Strategy, content production and community management.
- [Market Research](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/market-research): Market, audience and competitor research.
- [UGC Video](https://brandmakingtractor.com/services/ugc-video): User-generated-style video content for ads and social.
